branches.note: Florida dealer purchase — dealer is required by law to process the Application for Title. Customer does NOT need to file the title paperwork at the tax collector.

Out-of-state dealer purchase (new mobile home) — customer submits HSMV 82040 with manufacturer's certificate of origin, bill of sale showing purchase price and sales tax paid, and any applicable lien-holder information.

Previously titled out-of-state — surrender the OOS title. Sales tax paid to another state must be proved; Florida Use Tax may apply if purchased within 6 months. Full 6% Use Tax + local option tax applies to foreign-country imports.
Active lien — lien-holder information required on the title application; title issued to lienholder.
Transferring an existing mobile-home decal — present the current registration and decal number.

Customer owns the land under the mobile home — should apply for a Real Property (RP) decal instead of an annual registration. Requires Declaration of Real Property (DR-402) issued by the Property Appraiser first.
